The structural break in 2011 modifies the estimated value of the bye-week advantage, shifting from a significant benefit pre-CBA to minimal gain post-CBA. This implies that prior models overvalued the bye, which betting markets have begun to correct. The derived kernel maps these categorical modifiers into probabilistic outcomes, enabling GSI to compute confidence intervals and posterior probabilities for directional hypotheses. In GSE, this translates into state transitions based on game type and rest status, informing dynamic spread adjustments. The failure mode arises when categorical assumptions fail under heterogeneous team rest patterns or unmodeled interactions such as travel or timezone effects.
